description_text: This solicitation falls under FAR 16.5 and only applies to Prime Vendor Awardees on the Maritime Acquisition Advancement Contract (MAAC). They are the only vendors eligible to quote. If you are interested in being a supplier on this solicitation, the Prime Vendor Awardees are: Company Name CAGE Atlantic Diving Supply, Inc. - 1CAY9 ASRC Federal Facilities Logistics, LLC - 8FBE7 Culmen International, LLC – 33PP4 S&K Aerospace, LLC – 41ME5 SupplyCore, LLC – 4V314 Fairwinds Technologies, LLC - 7NJG1 Any non-Prime Vendor access requests submitted directly to DLA Mechanicsburg will be denied.
